content.short: Metacrafters is a community for developers to learn Web3 skills while earning from a gamified point system.
content.description: Metacrafters adopts a learn-to-earn approach to bring developers into Web3 ecosystems, welcoming both newcomers and experienced builders. New entrants can begin learning development at a comfortable pace, with current offerings that cover beginner and advanced Solana topics. In addition, courses for Solidity and Flow are planned to arrive soon. Seasoned developers who participate can apply to mentor fresh talent and earn rewards for their contributions.
